name: Kala Chana Masala
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) black chickpeas (kala chana), soaked overnight
1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp chilli powder and ¼ tsp turmeric
steps: Pressure-cook the chana with 2 cups water and salt for 6–7 whistles, until soft.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion, ginger and garlic for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the chana with its liquid and simmer for 12 minutes, mashing a few to thicken.
Finish with chana masala, lemon juice and coriander.
note: Black chickpeas are higher in fibre than white; always cook them until soft.
